Policies: Department read: any signed-in user; Forecast create/update: (@claims.role eq 'finance') and (@claims.email eq @item.owner_email); Forecast read: (@claims.role eq 'executive') or (@claims.email eq @item.owner_email); Actual read: (@claims.role eq 'executive') or (@claims.email eq @item.owner_email).

nodes.label: Sales Forecasting app
nodes.description: Editable forecast table with client-side validation, KPI cards and a monthly chart.

nodes.label: Forecast vs actual
nodes.description: Monthly chart read from Gold, scoped to the user's department unless executive.

nodes.label: Finance planner
nodes.description: Edits forecasts for their own department (synthetic user).

nodes.label: Executive
nodes.description: Reads every department; cannot edit (synthetic user).

annotations.text: SYNTHETIC: every user, row and number in this lab is generated.
One DuckLake snapshot per batch; latency is stamped on every write.
Row policies run on every call: planners edit only their own forecasts.
Policies do not reach the lake; the Gold read applies the department scope.
